jwt.notes: JWT access tokens (HS256, 30m expiry) and refresh tokens (30d) via shared/auth/jwt.py. Redis-backed blacklist for revocation (backend/app/security/auth.py:43-52). Token type discrimination (access vs refresh) at auth.py:90-91, 110-111. Dummy bcrypt hash for timing-safe login at auth.py:56. Perm_version invalidation in dependencies.py:64-77.

password_hashing.notes: bcrypt via shared/auth/passwords.py:6-16. hash_password() uses bcrypt.gensalt() (12 rounds default). verify_password() uses bcrypt.checkpw(). Dummy hash at backend/app/security/auth.py:56 prevents user enumeration.

session_management.notes: bump_perm_version() at backend/app/security/session.py:36-76 invalidates all active JWTs on role change, deactivation, password change, or lab_id change. Redis-backed perm_version check in dependencies.py:64-77. warm_perm_version() on login at session.py:79-87.

mfa.notes: Planned for Phase 2. No MFA implementation found in any security module.

intrusion_detection.notes: IntrusionDetector at backend/app/security/intrusion_detection.py:17-44. Time-windowed (300s) per-IP tracking with MAX_TRACKED_IPS=10000, MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_IP=100. Thread-safe with periodic cleanup. Dynamic IP blocking in rate_limit.py:119-123 when rate limit exceeded 5x.

rbac.notes: Backend RBAC via shared/rbac/permissions.py:36-102 (9 roles: super_admin, lab_admin, lab_tech, doctor, pathologist, nurse, receptionist, citizen, ministry, researcher). Extended string roles (9) with 16 permissions at permissions.py:108-189. require_permission() dependency at backend/app/security/dependencies.py:97-118.

national_rbac.notes: National-layer RBAC at backend/app/national/security/rbac.py:6-151. 16 NationalRole enums (system_admin through insurance_official) with 33 NationalPermission enums. RBACEngine with has_permission/has_any_permission/has_all_permissions at rbac.py:140-151.

abac.notes: Backend ABACEngine at backend/app/security/abac.py:65-144 with AttributeCondition operators (equals, not_equals, in, not_in, greater_than, less_than, contains, matches). National ABACEngine at backend/app/national/security/abac.py:51-88 with AccessRequest model supporting sensitive, VIP, minor, emergency, and purpose-of-use evaluation.

purpose_of_use.notes: PurposeOfUseEngine at backend/app/national/security/purpose_of_use.py:30-59. 10 purposes: TREATMENT, PAYMENT, OPERATIONS, RESEARCH, PUBLIC_HEALTH, QUALITY_IMPROVEMENT, EMERGENCY, FRAUD_DETECTION, DISCLOSURE, OTHER. Each purpose has consent/break-glass requirements. Integrated with national ABAC at abac.py:84-88.

consent.notes: Consent model at backend/app/models/consent.py:32-62. Status transitions: active -> revoked/expired. 5 scopes: read:patient, read:lab_results, read:orders, read:citizen, read:prescriptions. MAX_CONSENT_HOURS=72 at consent_service.py:56. require_consent() FastAPI dependency at security/consent_dep.py:74-195 with 4-tier evaluation: owner bypass, lab write-path bypass, emergency break-glass, normal consent check.

break_glass.notes: Four break-glass mechanisms: (1) consent_dep.py:68-71 X-Emergency-Access header for doctors; (2) national/security/break_glass.py:37-89 BreakGlassService with 6 reasons (EMERGENCY, PATIENT_SAFETY, PUBLIC_SAFETY, LEGAL, CONSENT_OBTAINED, OTHER); (3) governance/models/security.py:48-64 BreakGlassPolicy table with allowed_reasons, auto_approve_roles, max_duration_minutes; (4) national/security/emergency_access.py:23-62 EmergencyAccessService with admin notification and mandatory review.

minimum_necessary.notes: MinimumNecessaryEngine at backend/app/national/security/minimum_necessary.py:35-45. Field-level filtering per purpose: treatment, registration, billing, research, emergency, public_health. Each purpose defines exactly which fields are accessible. filter_data() method at minimum_necessary.py:39-41.

tenant_isolation.notes: Enforced at multiple levels: (1) require_own_lab() at backend/app/security/rbac.py:85-100 blocks cross-lab access; (2) get_current_user() at dependencies.py:80-86 checks lab.is_active; (3) get_current_lab() at dependencies.py:121-131; (4) idempotency keys scoped per lab at core/idempotency.py:120-134; (5) all patient-data queries MUST filter by lab_id per CLAUDE.md security invariants.

audit_logging.notes: SHA-256 hash chain at backend/app/models/audit_log.py:22-24 (chain_hash column). Immutability trigger at startup_guard.py:578-617 (BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger). HMAC-anchored checkpoint files at audit_service.py:55-77 (every 100 entries). Chain computation at audit_service.py:80-93. National audit with hash chain at national/security/audit.py:32-66. MPI merge audit at services/mpi/models.py:147. EdgeEvent at models/edge.py:210.

rate_limiting.notes: Rate limiter at backend/app/security/rate_limit.py:31-202. Fixed-window algorithm with Redis-backed counters. 4 tiers: rate_limit_public (30/min, rate_limit.py:152-157), rate_limit_user (60/min, rate_limit.py:160-177), rate_limit_auth (10/min, rate_limit.py:180-185), rate_limit_admin (20/min, rate_limit.py:188-202). Dynamic IP blocking at rate_limit.py:119-123. ConcurrencyLimitMiddleware at main.py:551-591 with max=200, clinical writes exempt. Dual-key strategy (user_id + IP) for authenticated endpoints.

at_rest.notes: Fernet (AES-128-CBC encrypt-then-MAC) via shared/security/encryption.py:15-26. National ID encryption with HMAC signing at encryption.py:29-46: encrypt_national_id() uses Fernet encrypt + HMAC-SHA256 sign; decrypt_national_id() verifies HMAC before decrypting. Key rotation support via NID_HMAC_KEY_PREV at audit_service.py:51.

in_transit.notes: TLS terminated at host nginx (api-gateway). HSTS header set in SecurityHeadersMiddleware at main.py:459: 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains'. CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options all set at main.py:434-460.

key_management.notes: Key rotation supported via NID_HMAC_KEY_PREV at audit_service.py:51. Fernet key validation at startup_guard.py:139-147. Weak secret detection at config.py:96-98 and startup_guard.py:109-111. SECRET_KEY, ENCRYPTION_KEY, REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET, NID_HMAC_KEY all hard-fail in production if missing (config.py:103-109, 122-129, 135-140, 145-149).

security_headers.notes: All set in SecurityHeadersMiddleware at backend/app/main.py:425-460. HSTS: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains (production only). CSP: default-src 'self', script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline', object-src 'none', frame-ancestors 'none'. Cache-Control: no-store for API responses, public for health probes.

input_validation.notes: MaxBodySizeMiddleware at main.py:257-274 (10MB default). SQLAlchemy ORM prevents SQL injection. Pydantic models enforce strict field definitions. CSP headers prevent XSS. Phone validation via Iraqi 07xx/9647xxx regex patterns. National ID validated as 12-15 digit strings.

api1_broken_oba.notes: JWT authentication (auth.py:76-94) + RBAC (rbac.py:68-79) + ABAC (abac.py:65-144) + consent enforcement (consent_dep.py:74-195) + PurposeOfUse (national/security/purpose_of_use.py:30-59). Multiple layered authorization gates.

api2_broken_auth.notes: JWT blacklist (auth.py:43-52) + perm_version invalidation (session.py:36-76) + intrusion detection (intrusion_detection.py:17-44) + rate limiting on auth endpoints (rate_limit.py:180-185). Token type discrimination (access vs refresh) at auth.py:90-91, 110-111.

api3_excessive_data.notes: MinimumNecessaryEngine at national/security/minimum_necessary.py:35-45 provides field-level filtering per purpose. Pydantic models enforce strict response schemas. No wildcard endpoints returning full DB rows.

api4_rate_limiting.notes: 4-tier rate limiting at backend/app/security/rate_limit.py:152-202 (public 30/min, authenticated 60/min, auth 10/min, admin 20/min). ConcurrencyLimitMiddleware at main.py:551-591 (max 200, clinical writes exempt). Dynamic IP blocking at rate_limit.py:119-123.

api5_broken_functions.notes: PolicyEngine at core/policy_engine.py:144-272 with default-deny for unknown actions. DecisionGuard at core/decision_guard.py:40-79 wraps all autonomous actions. RiskEngine at core/risk_engine.py:52-135 scores actions 0-10. Feature flags gate all new functionality.

api6_mass_assignment.notes: Pydantic models enforce strict field definitions for all request/response schemas. No raw request.data usage. All input validated through Pydantic BaseModel subclasses.

api7_security_misconfig.notes: startup_guard.py:114-166 validates config at boot (weak secret detection, missing keys). config.py:96-98 _is_weak_secret() blocks default/placeholder values. Hard fail on missing SECRET_KEY, ENCRYPTION_KEY, REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET, NID_HMAC_KEY in production.

api8_injection.notes: SQLAlchemy ORM prevents SQL injection. Pydantic models validate all input. CSP headers prevent XSS. MaxBodySizeMiddleware prevents oversized payloads.

api9_improper_asset_management.notes: Versioned APIs via APP_VERSION header (main.py:417). Deprecation headers available. API docs gated behind admin JWT in production (main.py:314-348). Route versioning via router prefixes.

api10_logging_monitoring.notes: Hash-chained audit logging (audit_log.py:22-24, audit_service.py:80-93). Immutable DB trigger (startup_guard.py:578-617). HMAC-anchored checkpoint files (audit_service.py:105-115). Health watchdog with GREEN/YELLOW/RED scoring (main.py). Sentry error tracking (main.py:48-71). Structured JSON logging (logging_config.py).

compliance.iso_27001: A.8.15 audit, A.9 access control, A.10 cryptography
compliance.iraqi_moh: national_id encryption (Fernet + HMAC), consent enforcement, break-glass, audit chain, purpose-of-use, minimum necessary

circuit_breaker.notes: CircuitBreaker at core/self_healing.py:49-138. DB circuit: 3 failures, 30s recovery timeout. Redis circuit: 5 failures, 20s recovery timeout. States: CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN with auto-transition.

degraded_mode.notes: DegradationLevel at self_healing.py:144-159: NONE(0), L1_CACHE_HEAVY(1), L2_READ_ONLY(2), L3_CRITICAL_ONLY(3). DegradedModeMiddleware at self_healing.py:353-409. L2 blocks POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH. L3 blocks all except health, auth, kill-switch, metrics.

recovery_worker.notes: RecoveryWorker at self_healing.py:415-458. Probes DB and Redis circuits. 30s normal interval, 10s degraded interval.

kill_switch.notes: Three activation mechanisms at core/kill_switch.py:46-71: in-memory flag (API), Redis key (cross-instance), env var (KILL_SWITCH=true). Blocks all autonomous AI/repair actions. API traffic continues unaffected. Admin endpoints at /admin/kill-switch/*.

policy_engine.notes: PolicyEngine at core/policy_engine.py:144-272. 17 ActionTypes with risk levels (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL). Default DENY for unknown actions. Frequency-aware with hourly limits. Kill switch integration. DecisionGuard at core/decision_guard.py:40-79 wraps all autonomous actions.

risk_engine.notes: RiskEngine at core/risk_engine.py:52-135. 6 factors: environment (+3 prod), data impact (+3 patient data), blast radius (+2 all tenants), reversibility (+2 irreversible), frequency (+2 high freq), recency (+1 within 5min). Score thresholds: 0-2 LOW, 3-5 MEDIUM, 6-8 HIGH, 9-10 CRITICAL.

idempotency.notes: IdempotencyKey middleware at core/idempotency.py:94-171. Keys scoped per lab (prevents cross-lab replay). 24-hour TTL. ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for concurrent request safety. Supported on POST endpoints for clinical data.

runtime_guard.notes: Runtime isolation at core/runtime_guard.py:43-49. 4 modes: api, worker, test, cli. Edge table access guard at runtime_guard.py:65-95 blocks edge_* table access outside worker runtime. assert_worker_runtime() at runtime_guard.py:43-49.

startup_guard.notes: Atomic startup validation at core/startup_guard.py:623-713. Step 1: validate_config() checks secrets not weak/missing. Step 2: wait_for_db() with exponential backoff (15 retries). Step 3: check_migrations() verifies 7 required tables. Step 4: seed_critical_data() (perm_version, test types, master admin, audit trigger). Step 5: kernel bootstrap. system_ready flag gates all traffic via ReadinessMiddleware.

governance_models.notes: 8 governance security tables at backend/app/governance/models/security.py: NationalAuditEvent, SecurityPolicy, BreakGlassPolicy, ThreatIntelligenceEvent, IncidentRecord, RiskRegistryItem, DataClassification, DigitalCertificate. Full incident management lifecycle (detect, contain, resolve, lessons learned). Risk registry with likelihood/impact scoring. Data classification with PII/PHI flags.
